subject: PO metadata, net terms options and weekly invoice sweep / packaging questions
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@silverline-retail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@silverline-retail.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T09:42:00+01:00
Subject: PO fields / weekly invoice sweep exception request

Hi Markus,

Quick procurement question as we move through final internal approvals for the Redwood proof-of-concept purchase. Our AP team requires a tight PO->invoice mapping before they will accept weekly invoice runs. Two asks: 

1) Can you confirm the exact PO fields Redwood needs on invoices so our ERP can push the right metadata? (PO number, PO line, billing entity, tax id, remit-to, GL code, etc.)
2) We prefer weekly statement/invoice stubs (to reconcile shipments), with one consolidated settlement each month. Our default net is Net-45 — would Redwood consider Net-30 for a committed annual volume? Any discount structure tied to faster payment?

If helpful, I've attached our procurement guidelines. Also: one of our constraints is that any weekly invoice requires a 48-hour PO acceptance window to avoid duplicate billing. Would Redwood be able to support that process?

Thanks — can we take 30 minutes Thursday to align?

Best,
Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement, Silverline Retail
Sophie.Martin@silverline-retail.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachment: Silverline_PO_Guidelines_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@silverline-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T12:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: PO fields / weekly invoice sweep exception request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear note. Happy to align — proposed summary below and next steps.

1) PO fields Redwood requires (standard):
   - PO Number (required)
   - PO Line / Line Item ID (recommended)
   - Billing Entity (company name + tax/VAT ID)
   - Remit-To / Payment Instructions (bank/IBAN or wire details)
   - Invoice Date and Billing Period
   - Itemized token/usage lines or SKU mapping + quantity
   - Internal GL/Cost Center (optional but helpful)
   - Contact for disputes

2) Weekly stubs + monthly settlement: we can accommodate a weekly stub cadence where we emit an "invoice stub" each week and a consolidated invoice/settlement at month end. Requirements on our side for that flow:
   - A PO acceptance window (48h) is reasonable and helps prevent duplicate processing.
   - We need a stable PO identifier (idempotency) for each week to map credits/adjustments.
   - If Silverline can include a GL code/Cost Center on the PO, it will speed reconciliations.

3) Net terms and discount: standard hosted contracts are Net-45. We can offer:
   - Net-30 with a 1.5% volume-linked discount (annual commit)
   - Net-45 with a 1.0% discount if you prefer looser cashflow
   - Alternatively, Net-30 for the POC period with the 1.5% discount conditioned on a signed annual order by month-end.

I've attached our PO template and a SOC2 overview you can include for internal auditors. Ben / Kimberly are cc'd to confirm finance and billing mechanics (EDD/EDI mapping, PO acceptance flags).

Next actions:
 - Ben/Kimberly validate the reconciliation/acceptance flow below (Ben: see question on EDI 810 mapping).
 - Sophie: if this looks OK, we'll prepare a finalized quote + Docusign package and schedule a 30-min alignment call.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +44 7700 123456

Attachments: Silverline_PO_template_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); redwood_SOC2_overview.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@silverline-retail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:22:00+01:00
Subject: Re: PO fields / weekly invoice sweep exception request

On 19 Sep 2026, Markus Klein wrote:
> I've attached our PO template and a SOC2 overview you can include for internal auditors. Ben / Kimberly are cc'd to confirm finance and billing mechanics (EDD/EDI mapping, PO acceptance flags).

Thanks for the context. A couple of notes from finance:

- Weekly invoice stubs are workable, but for our AP toolchain we need an "acceptance code" field returned from your side indicating the PO was ingested and accepted. That acceptance code must be generated within 48 hours of PO submission.
- We support EDI 810 style mapping for the consolidated invoice. If Silverline cannot emit EDI, we can accept a well-structured CSV with the same columns.
- For reconciliation we need a documented invoice reconciliation flow (basic SLA: disputed items flagged within 7 business days). I've attached our standard "invoice_recon_flow.pdf" for reference.

If Silverline agrees to the 48h acceptance and can populate a GL/Cost Center attribute on the PO, billing ops will sign off on weekly stubs leading to monthly settlement. Otherwise we need to default to monthly invoices.

Ben
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: invoice_recon_flow.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@silverline-retail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@silverline-retail.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:18:00+01:00
Subject: Re: PO fields / weekly invoice sweep exception request

Hi all — thanks, this is helpful. Quick update from Silverline procurement:

- We can accept the proposed 48-hour PO acceptance window as long as Redwood provides the acceptance code within that timeframe.
- We will attempt to push Net-30 (with the 1.5% discount) through our CFO for the annual commit; if leadership pushes back we'll accept Net-45 at 1.0% as a fallback.
- We'll provide either EDI 810 or the CSV mapping by tomorrow EOD.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the final quote + Docusign package reflecting Net-30 @1.5% (and alternate Net-45 @1.0%) and confirm the attach/ack flow for acceptance codes so we can route to AP. Once we have the Docusign I will route for procurement + finance signoff and book the 30-min call — propose Thursday 09:00 BST.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Sophie
Attachment: Silverline_PO_Guidelines_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
